in_sanskrit.name: Chahna

In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the goddess Parvati, in her form as Shakti, is the embodiment of this feeling. Chahna is a name that evokes a deep sense of yearning and passion, and is often given to girls who are thought to possess these traits.
